title: MM-INSTRUCTEVAL: Zero-Shot Evaluation of (Multimodal) Large Language Models on Multimodal Reasoning Tasks
reasoning: The paper presents an evaluation framework (MM-INSTRUCTEVAL) to assess multimodal reasoning tasks such as sarcasm detection, sentiment analysis, and relation extraction. It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its benchmarking, although it includes a 'hateful meme detection' task which is framed as a multimodal reasoning/fusion challenge rather than an ethical evaluation.
